inventory_command: SELECT n.nspname,t.relname,i.relname,x.indisunique,pg_get_indexdef(x.indexrelid) FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(x.indcollation) AS c(oid) WHERE c.oid<>0) ORDER BY t.relname,i.relname;
risk: Collation-dependent indexes including unique constraints require independent verification; an index listed here is potentially affected, not proof of corruption.
